description: Pay for one option of a quote and open the test. The price is the option's ad budget in USDC on Base, paid over x402. Call it first without `payment`: the answer is an x402 payment request for the exact amount. Pay it with an x402 client and call again with the payment as `payment` (the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value). A person reviews every test before its ads run; a declined test is refunded in full. Use sandbox: true to try the whole flow on Base Sepolia with test USDC; a sandbox test runs no ads and moves through its states in minutes.

idempotency_key.description: Any string. Sending the same one again returns the same test and never charges twice.

option.description: Which of the quote's options to pay for. Default signal.

payment.description: The x402 payment, base64, as an x402 client creates it. Leave out to get the payment request.

quote_id.description: The quote_id from quote_test. Quotes hold for 30 minutes.

sandbox.description: Base Sepolia and test USDC; no ads run. Default false.

webhook_url.description: A public https address told of every change, signed with the webhook_secret returned once.

name: start_test
title: Pay for a test
